memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, manages florist shop, walks to market without aid.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw normal) – negative screen.
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds – normal.
medicines: 0 regular (new patient).
mood: reports occasional frustration with bloating, denies depression.
carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby.
goal: "I want to stay active at work and enjoy my garden without tummy trouble."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.2 g/dl (12-16), WBC 6.8 x10^9/l (4-10), Plt 210 x10^9/l (150-400).
Stool routine: ova/cyst nil, pus cells 0-1/hpf, negative for occult blood.
tTG-IgA: 4 U/ml (<7 negative).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg tablet BD
ispaghula husk 5 g powder OD
loperamide 2 mg capsule SOS max 8/24h
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler BD

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: continues florist work, notes mild abdominal discomfort after heavy lifting.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 – stable.
falls: no falls, gait normal, TUG 9 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (mebeverine, ispaghula, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol, loperamide PRN). Polypharmacy – request review against Beers.
mood: reports occasional low mood linked to symptom flare.
carers: daughter Priya.
goal: "I’d like fewer days with bloating so I can keep up with orders."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 13.0 g/dl, WBC 7.0, Plt 205.
tTG-IgA: 5 U/ml (negative).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (55% pred), FVC 2.90 L (78% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.58 (<0.70) – consistent with moderate COPD.
No significant bronchodilator response.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD (unchanged)
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler BD (increase to 2 puffs BD)
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
loperamide 2 mg SOS

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-10-15 at 10:30 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports good energy, occasional shortness of breath on climbing stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 – stable.
falls: no falls, gait slightly slower, TUG 10 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (mebeverine, ispaghula, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol, loperamide PRN). Polypharmacy – note Beers review pending.
mood: denies depression, reports occasional anxiety about breathlessness.
carers: daughter Priya.
goal: "I want to walk to the market without stopping for breath."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.8 g/dl, WBC 6.9, Plt 200.
Stool routine: normal flora, no ova/cysts, occult blood negative.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Chest X-ray: lungs hyperinflated, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation or pleural effusion. Cardiac size within normal limits.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
loperamide discontinued (no SOS needed)
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler BD (2 puffs BD)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: manages shop, occasional fatigue after long days.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 – stable; annual screen due.
falls: no falls, gait steady, TUG 9 seconds.
medicines: 5 regular (mebeverine, ispaghula, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol). Polypharmacy threshold met – recommend Beers review.
mood: reports feeling low on rainy days, denies hopelessness.
carers: daughter Priya.
goal: "I’d like to keep my energy steady through the week."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.9 g/dl, WBC 7.1, Plt 202.
tTG-IgA: 6 U/ml (still negative).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Repeat spirometry: FEV1 1.72 L (56% pred), FVC 2.95 L (80% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.58 – unchanged moderate COPD.
No significant change from prior.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD
ispaghula husk 5 g OD
tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD
salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 mcg inhaler BD (2 puffs BD)
add: roflumilast 500 mg OD (for COPD exacerbation prevention)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: ‘Doctor, my bloating has worsened over the past week, especially after eating out. I’ve been taking mebeverine regularly but it doesn’t help as much. Also I feel a bit wheezy after walking to the market.’

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild abdominal discomfort after meals, manages shop with occasional rest.
cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 – stable; annual screen negative.
falls: no falls in last year, gait slightly antalgic, TUG 11 seconds – borderline risk; advise strengthening exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 6 regular (mebeverine, ispaghula, tiotropium, salbutamol, budesonide-formoterol, roflumilast). Polypharmacy – Beers review recommended.
mood: denies depression, notes frustration with GI symptoms.
carers: daughter Priya.
goal: "I want to enjoy my florist work without worrying about my stomach or breathing."
